mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM acc_satisfaction_questionnaire_template_revision r JOIN acc_satisfaction_questionnaire_template t ON t.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND t.id = r.template_id AND t.current_revision_id = r.id AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.deleted = b'0' WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.template_id = #{query.templateId} AND r.id = #{query.templateRevisionId} AND r.revision_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted = b'0'
